title: Dracula: A Record of the Unquiet Dead

prologue.text: A sequence of journals, letters, telegrams, and records begins with a solicitor travelling east.

scenes.name: The Golden Krone Inn
scenes.setting: Bistritz, Transylvania — evening at the Golden Krone Inn
scenes.openingNarration: By evening I had reached Bistritz, where the innkeeper received me with a warning he would not explain. My road to the Borgo Pass begins here, but the room is full of uneasy glances, hurried prayers, and one name spoken only when the door is shut: Dracula.
